up: Retrieve approved drugs from ChEMBL with preferred name, canonical SMILES, max clinical phase, mechanism of action, action type, target ChEMBL ID, and target name. Keep only approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have both a drug_mechanism row and a compound_structures row with canonical_smiles. Return DISTINCT rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Preserve INNER JOIN semantics from molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and to compound_structures, but use LEFT JOIN semantics from drug_mechanism to target_dictionary (target columns may be null).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.max_phase,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  dm.action_type,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
WHERE md.max_phase = 4;
